 Hollywood actor pays tribute to Sami Zayn during The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon appearance
 By  Rosanne Raphael 
 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 06:39

 Sami Zayn holds the undisputed WWE Championship aloft. (Image credit: WWE) 
 Actor Kieran Culkin appeared on the November 18 edition of The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon wearing Sami Zayn ‘justice’ t-shirt. 
 Zayn acknowledged the actor’s support with a repost of his photo from the NBC show on Instagram and captioned it ‘Justice’. 
 Culkin had previously attended WWE Raw’s Netflix debut in 2025 where he shared a moment with CM Punk from ringside, after his victory over Seth Rollins. 
 Zayn’s journey to become Undisputed WWE Champion was fuelled by years of perseverance and desire to receive the recognition he feels he deserves. However, his frustrations continue to grow with him believing he needs ‘justice’ for the disrespect faced from fans and those who doubted his abilities. 
 At Crown Jewel earlier this month, Zayn earned Roman Reigns’ respect after their champion vs. match, marking a vital moment in his quest to prove himself to the WWE locker room.
